answer: Before serving traffic, each agent must mint a compute voucher by cracking a unique walnut: a one-off puzzle whose shell binds to its address and nonce, so no solution is shareable. Valid vouchers stamp onto a public onyx ledger anyone can audit. At each cycle's nadir, a random slice of live agents re-proves vouchers; stale or borrowed stamps burn the identity. A sybil with N puppets cracks N walnuts, pays N compute bills, and survives N audits; no bulk shortcut exists. An honest agent cracks one walnut, pays once, stays valid.
